title: Private Romantic Walking Tour in Montreal Historic Heritage
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a private, romantic journey through Montreal’s most cherished locales on our tour. Walk hand in hand through the historic heart of the city, from the timeless elegance of Place d’Armes to the bustling energy of Place Jacques-Cartier. Discover unique treasures at the Bonsecours Market and seek tranquility at the Notre-Dame-de-Bon-Secours Chapel. Cap off your enchanting day with a sunset stroll along the Old Port, where the city’s history blends seamlessly with the beauty of the St. Lawrence River. Make yourself the hero of your love story with this unforgettable romantic escapade.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
